stem: Ethanedioic acid, $\text{HO}_2\text{CCO}_2\text{H}$, has a relative molecular mass of 90.0.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term relative molecular mass.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the empirical formula of ethanedioic acid.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Calculate how many atoms of carbon are present in 0.18 g of ethanedioic acid, $\text{HO}_2\text{CCO}_2\text{H}$.

Show your working.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Solid ethanedioic acid reacts with aqueous calcium ions to make a precipitate of calcium ethanedioate, $\text{CaC}_2\text{O}_4$.

$\text{CaC}_2\text{O}_4$ breaks down when heated to form calcium oxide, carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Construct an equation to represent the reaction of $\text{CaC}_2\text{O}_4$ when heated. Include state symbols.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the type of reaction which occurs when $\text{CaC}_2\text{O}_4$ is heated.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Identify another compound containing calcium ions which will also produce carbon dioxide and calcium oxide when it is heated.
